workload.path: Real Files v4 import then ordinary saveAsync metadata edits, final full compatibility reopen
workload.sameFinalData: All eight arrays and vault/snapshot identity match expected edited fixture; unchanged private receipt descriptor/ciphertext and raw bytes
workload.measurementScope: On-disk metadata record/pointer file counts and byte lengths only; not total allocated blocks, latency, energy or production performance

behavior.retention: Current and immediate predecessor record bodies plus the immediate predecessor wrapper. Pending state prevents collection. Root lease and pinned inode/hash rechecks govern unlink. Candidate metadata uses SH flock; reader-locked historical records retain all overlapping receipt provenance. Metadata is processed one record at a time.
behavior.deletionAuthority: Full authenticated metadata/model/native receipt validation required for old records; exact authenticated pointer wrappers and full validated inline legacy predecessors handled separately. No deletion authority from missing or empty returned receipt descriptors.
behavior.automaticTrigger: After successful shared publication/finalization, outside rollback catch. Cleanup cancellation/error logs deferred cleanup and returns the committed result.
behavior.observability: storage-retention OSLog counters and an internal CollectionReport record removals, quarantined/pinned entries and automatic failure. No user-content/path/key logging. Quarantine means retained in place, not moved.
behavior.limits: Unreadable/tampered/unknown history and retained pins are excluded from settled two-record bound; they may retain bytes indefinitely. Partial cleanup errors can leave quarantined history. No janitorial override of unreadable evidence.

reviewCorrections: Nonblocking pre-fstat metadata and receipt opens prevent unknown FIFO hangs; regular files retain existing type/protection/size checks. Actual mkfifo preservation through ordinary saves passed.
Preservation prepass prevents deleting a receipt shared with another reader-pinned historical record; overlapping B/C pins with shared A regression passed.
Hosted stale-incarnation test removes only redundant replace after eager legacy migration; exact same-revision/different-epoch/stale-install assertions remain and final method passed.
proofLimits: New VaultStore instances in same XCTest process; simulated interruption checkpoints, not a new forced process-death run.
Injected cleanup error/cancellation and actual unlink/recreate/FIFO operations; not a real full-volume or hardware fsync-failure experiment.
Compile-time simulator filesystem mode; physical class-A protection, lock/reboot and Files-provider behavior not retested.
No UI/full performance/cloud matrix rerun; no timing improvement claim.
estimatedTokens: Approximately 14–16k including review-driven FIFO/overlap corrections, beyond initial 10k soft estimate; no subagents spawned
